colour/group-metallic.definition: Colours whose name contains Metallic, Pearl, Chrome, Flat Silver or Flat Dark Gold (rule of this repository).

colour/group-special.definition: Colours whose name contains Glitter, Speckle, Milky, Glow, Satin, Opal or Neon (rule of this repository).
colour/group-special.label: Special effect
colour/group-special.note: Classification rule is derived by this repository, not by LEGO.

colour/group-transparent.definition: Translucent colours; Rebrickable marks them with is_trans and a Trans- prefix.

colour/light-gray.label: Light Gray

colour/tan.label: Tan

colour/trans-clear.label: Trans-Clear

feature/hollow-underside.definition: Cavity enclosed by the walls on the underside of a brick.
feature/hollow-underside.label: Hollow underside

feature/stud.definition: Cylindrical protrusion on top of an element; nominal diameter 4.8 mm and height about 1.7 mm.
feature/stud.label: Stud
feature/stud.note: Variant values: Ø 4.5 to 5 mm, height 1.6 to 1.86 mm (orionrobots-specs, diyhpl-dimensions).

feature/underside-tube.definition: Cylinder on the underside of a brick; the source gives an outer diameter of about 6.3 to 6.6 mm.

identifier-system/bricklink-id.definition: Part number in the BrickLink catalogue; may differ from the LEGO design ID.
identifier-system/bricklink-id.label: BrickLink part number

identifier-system/design-id.definition: Number moulded on the piece; it does not encode the colour.
identifier-system/design-id.label: Design ID

identifier-system/element-id.definition: Identifies a design in one specific colour; the same design in four colours has four element IDs.
identifier-system/element-id.label: Element ID

identifier-system/ldraw-id.definition: Part number in the LDraw library.
identifier-system/ldraw-id.label: LDraw part number

identifier-system/rebrickable-id.definition: Part number in the Rebrickable catalogue.
identifier-system/rebrickable-id.label: Rebrickable part number

part/3005.label: Brick 1 x 1
part/3005.note: Geometry from brick-dimensions; part number not confirmed

part/3020.label: Plate 2 x 4
part/3020.note: Geometry from brick-dimensions (plate 15.8 x 31.8 x 3.2 mm)

part/3626.label: Minifig Head
part/3626.note: Many printed variants exist; designs with suffix letters are separate entries in Rebrickable

part/4073.label: Plate Round 1 x 1
part/4073.note: LEGO design ID 6141, BrickLink 4073; the transparent version carries design ID 30057 (brickfact-identify). Round footprint: studs_length/width describe the 1 x 1 grid cell only.

part/baseplate.definition: Large flat plate on the stud grid, for example 32 x 32 studs = 256 mm.
part/baseplate.label: Baseplate

part/brick.definition: Rectangular building element one brick high: 9.6 mm without the stud, equal to three plates.
part/brick.label: Brick

part/minifig-part.definition: Part of a minifigure: head, torso, hips, legs, arms, hands or headwear.
part/minifig-part.label: Minifigure part
part/minifig-part.note: Category 'Minifig Headwear' appears in the cited parts lists.

part/plate.definition: Rectangular building element one third of a brick high: 3.2 mm.
part/plate.label: Plate

part/tile.definition: Element of plate height (3.2 mm) used for flat surfaces.
part/tile.label: Tile
part/tile.note: Studless top surface is author knowledge, not stated in the cited source.

unit/brick-height.definition: Height of a brick without stud; three plates.
unit/brick-height.label: Brick height

unit/ldu.definition: Unit of the LDraw format; 1 LDU = 0.4 mm. Brick height 24, plate height 8, stud pitch 20.
unit/ldu.label: LDraw unit (LDU)

unit/lego-unit.definition: 1.6 mm; a stud pitch is 5 LU, a plate 2 LU, a brick 6 LU.
unit/lego-unit.label: LEGO unit (LU)

unit/part-gap.definition: Each part is 0.2 mm shorter than its grid, 0.1 mm per side.
unit/part-gap.label: Part gap

unit/plate-height.definition: Height of a plate, without stud.
unit/plate-height.label: Plate height

unit/stud-height.label: Stud height
unit/stud-height.note: References give 1.6 to 1.86 mm; brick-dimensions uses 1.8 mm.

unit/stud-pitch.definition: Centre-to-centre spacing of studs; the basic grid unit.
unit/stud-pitch.label: Stud pitch
